rules.name: model-is-pure
rules.reason: The core domain model must stay pure with zero outward dependencies.

rules.name: lint-depends-only-on-model
rules.reason: Lint rules operate purely on the domain Model and Graph.

rules.name: allow-depends-only-on-model
rules.reason: Allowlist logic depends only on diagnostic keys and lint types.

rules.name: format-depends-only-on-model
rules.reason: Formatters render Model diagnostics without coupling to analysis or CLI.

rules.name: workspace-no-analyzer-or-cli
rules.reason: Workspace discovery is an infrastructure leaf beneath the analyzer.

rules.name: analyzer-no-lint-or-cli
rules.reason: The TypeScript analyzer produces a Model without knowing which lints consume it.

rules.name: github-no-cli
rules.reason: GitHub governance logic stays independent from CLI argument parsing.
